jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Overview:

Are you a passionate about environmental stewardship? As the Environmental Specialist, you will provide technical input on environmental monitoring and design or construction methods to ensure compliance with environmental specifications or regulatory standards.

Bring your diverse ideas to build stronger, more resilient communities.

Apply now and transform your career with us.

What you will be doing:

* Audits, analyzes, and reports on environmental performance to internal and external clients, as well as regulatory bodies.
* Collaborates with design and construction teams to advise on minimizing adverse environmental impacts.
* Conducts impact assessments to identify, evaluate, and mitigate environmental risks and financial costs.
* Prepares environmental reports for supervisor review and leadership presentations.
* Raises awareness across the organization about emerging environmental issues and coordinates public hearings and consultations.
* Trains staff at all levels on environmental issues and responsibilities, and engages in environmental education and research to stay ahead of industry trends.

What we are looking for:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Environmental Science, Biology, or a related environmental field required.
* Environmental certification preferred.
* Experience in environmental monitoring preferred.

Why work for us:

Some of the benefits you may be eligible for as an employee are:

* Comprehensive compensation package and paid time off program
* Industry leading 401(k)/RRSP
* Medical/Extended Health Care, Dental, Vision and/or Provincial Medical
* Wellness benefits & Employee Assistance Program
* Tuition Reimbursement Program

We are an EEO/ADA/Veterans employer.

Salary Min: USD $78,000.00/Yr. Salary Max: USD $82,000.00/Yr.

jobs.title: Environmental Science Specialist
jobs.description:
At PGE, our work involves dreaming about, planning for, and realizing a smarter, cleaner, more enduring Oregon neighborhood. Its core to our DNA and we haven’t stopped since we started in 1888. We energize lives, strengthen communities and drive advancements in energy that promote social, economic and environmental progress. We’re always on the lookout for people passionate about leading and being a part of teams that are advancing innovative clean energy solutions that are also affordable and accessible to all.

**Environmental Science Specialist**
====================================

**Job ID:** 6196 | **Grade:** 7 | **Career Level:** P3 – Career Professional

**Job Summary**

Supports the implementation of environmental programs to ensure regulatory obligations are fulfilled and environmental risks are effectively mitigated. May specialize in areas such as air quality, stormwater management, hazardous materials and waste management, and ongoing regulatory reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Practices and promotes PGE safety and environmental culture by helping to ensure compliance with standards, objectives, and regulatory requirements.
* Proactively identifies potential environmental risks and challenges and supports process to resolution.
* Performs moderately complex assessments and technical analyses within assigned areas.
* May lead or coordinate small or less complex projects, report preparation, data compilation and analyses, field studies, and project site visits.
* May lead or participate in agency inspections, meetings, and reviews.
* Will work to develop knowledge and skill sets within the assigned technical areas through coaching and training opportunities, internal and external, with potential for conference attendance as appropriate.

* Actively coordinates with internal and external team members to support effective best management practices and project outcomes.
* Works collaboratively with key internal partners, agencies, NGOs, and contractors to maintain compliance and effectively communicates methods to achieve such.
* May lead or participate in providing trainings and presentations, internal and external.
* Depending on assigned area, may be required to obtain professional training and/or certification.

**Education, Experience, and Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in environmental science, policy, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience may be referenced in lieu of education.

**Functional Competencies**

* Ability to interpret technical content.
* General knowledge of industry and technology trends.
* General knowledge of industry rules, regulations, and basic regulatory development processes, or a demonstrated ability to learn and track such.
* Working knowledge of office applications, including Microsoft Word and Excel.

**Physical and Cognitive Demands**

**Cognitive Level**

**Substantial:** Consistently utilizes logic and critical thinking to define problems, gather information, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

**Schedule and Attendance Requirements**

* Adheres to established work schedules, including start and end times and lunch periods, where applicable.
* Ability to work extended hours.
* Ability to work a variable schedule.
* Ability to report to work and perform duties during periods of severe inclement weather.
* Maintains regular, reliable, and predictable attendance consistent with full-time position requirements.
* Ability to participate in an on-call schedule.
* Ability to travel within territory for site visits, project meetings, agency inspections.

**Physical Capabilities**

* Driving/travel/commute: Daily within service territory - Frequently **(at least once a week or more)**
* Computer use (use computer regularly for entire work shift)
* Lifting/pushing/pulling: Up to 10 lbs.
* Carrying: Up to 10 lbs.

**Environment - Indoor/Outdoor (check all that apply):**

* Office
* Plant
* Field

Actual total compensation, including a performance based incentive bonus, is commensurate with experience, skills, qualifications, education, training, and internal equity.
